fee_roundtrip_usd_per_oz.source: Baseline commission set by the user on 2026-10-26; used by spectrum.economics and execution configs

spread_default_usd_per_oz.source: Set by the user on 2026-10-26; used only where the spread was not measured

crossing_opportunity_cooldown_ns.source: Calibrated 2026-10-26 on bb_crossing_bank_v2 (8 days, scales 1 and 9): re-crossings of one line with no other line between show a scale-free hazard (about 0.7/gap); the median mid excursion during the silence first exceeds the round trip cost of 5 ticks (spread 0.2 + fee 0.3 USD/oz) at about 8 s

layers.rule: Measurements and future facts carry no costs. Money enters only in spectrum.economics (and execution rules in spectrum.execution).
layers.stored_future_facts: Nothing future is stored by default; future.future_crossings is computed on demand from a stored bank (events + reduced quote tape)
layers.future_rule: Bands and the crossing bank use only the past: a crossing is a past fact at its own t_ns. Anything seen forward from an origin lives in spectrum.future, and every such function and field is named with 'future'. Future carries four marks (spectrum.leakage): the word 'future' in every name ('futures' is the contract kind, not the word); the FutureFrame/FutureSeries type that survives pandas operations; value fingerprints of every future column and of values derived from it, also as masked zero and float32; and time, future.future_examples being the only join of X and Y (X published by the origin, Y matured after it, optional cutoff). Model input (FeatureBatch, feature Context, SequenceStore, observation store, to_feature_batch) rejects all of them.
layers.maturity: future_maturity_ns = time of the crossing, or origin + horizon, or end of the band segment

crossing_rule.rule: A band line is crossed at a publication where bid OR ask changes side of it (side = price >= line)
crossing_rule.consequence: Above-price line: crossed when ask reaches it; below-price line: when bid reaches it; a line moving through a still quote also crosses; a midpoint crossing usually gives two events (ask reaches the line, then bid passes it)
crossing_rule.first_publication: First publication of a support segment only sets the sides
crossing_rule.band_geometry: Bands themselves are built from the midpoint
crossing_rule.clusters: Every crossing stays in the bank, flicker included. Markers per line, past only: line_visit = first crossing since another line of the same scale was crossed (or first of the segment); opportunity = line_visit OR silence on this line since its previous crossing >= crossing_opportunity_cooldown_ns. A cluster is an opportunity and the crossings of the same line after it; crossings at one publication do not count as 'between' each other
crossing_rule.implementation: spectrum.crossings.bank.crossing_rows and crossing_clusters (geometry QUOTE_NATIVE_BID_OR_ASK_CLUSTER_V3), banks in data/derived/bb_crossing_bank_v3; spectrum.future.bands.future E (band exit)

rules.rule: Preserve DBN source order; never concatenate or append to a raw archive
A book update is published only at the F_LAST of its event group; partial groups are never visible
Availability clock is the provider receive time ts_recv; processing wall time is measured separately
Prices and clocks stay exact integers (nano-USD, UTC ns) until a declared unit conversion
Gaps, resets and epoch changes are never bridged; each starts a new continuity epoch
Unknown values are stored as zero with a false mask, never as an observed zero
Instrument route is fixed before reconstruction without looking at outcomes

open_questions: Front-month roll rule is not yet declared in the canon
